definition: Go for it; keep it up. Literally 'add fuel' — the standard way to cheer someone on.
So-so; careless. Used both for 'not bad' and for sloppy work.
When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
To kill two birds with one stone.
example: 这样安排可以一石二鸟。

definition: Excuse me; sorry — also 'embarrassed'. Softer than 对不起.
Almost; about the same; good enough.
example: 时间差不多了，我们走吧。

definition: It is nothing; no problem; I am fine.
Take your time; one step at a time.
That makes sense; you have a point.
Whatever you like; casual; as one pleases.
To flatter; to suck up. Literally 'pat the horse's rump'.
To pull strings; to use back-door connections.
example: 这件事他是走后门办成的。
